composed_chunk_self_test.contract:
composed_chunk_self_test (new feature):
  Profile A — Automatic Recovery: claimed — 21 generated cases
  Profile B — Bounded Ownership: claimed — 12 generated cases
  Profile C — Crash Ambiguity: claimed — 9 generated cases
  Profile D — Durable Retention: not applicable — Registered policy retains work and evidence indefinitely.
  Profile E — Eventual Convergence: claimed — 60 generated cases
    STALE_SNAPSHOTS: NotApplicable — A fixed batch refuses new inputs; no desired revision can supersede its captured membership.
    MONOTONIC_RESULTS: Claim
    IN_FLIGHT: NotApplicable — This immutable cohort has no competing desired-state writer; receipt actors are covered by evidence confluence.
    EVIDENCE_CONFLUENCE: Claim
  Interleaving [bulk-partial-receipts]: 24 unique fixed histories; 0 declared legacy gaps
    Not applicable: retry turnover: Both members were accepted; partial receipt delivery must settle without another provider call.
  Interleaving [bulk-receipts-across-subset-retry]: 31 unique fixed histories; 0 declared legacy gaps
  Profile F — Fact-Derived Obligations: not applicable — No canonical discovery is registered.
  Profile G — Gated Execution: not applicable — The production capability has no execution gate.
  Profile H — Harmless Replay: declined — Production requires definite provider evidence; another call can duplicate an occurrence.
  Profile I — Indivisible Admission: not applicable — The producer inserts business intent and coordination in one row; the rollback control proves they cannot split.
  Profile J — Job Retry Limits: claimed — 4 generated cases
  Extra bounded_completion_commit_histories: applied
  Extra bounded_receipt_recovery: applied
  Extra bounded_receipt_detects_lost_recovery: applied
  Extra bounded_receipt_detects_duplicate_effect: applied

required_by.C: provider operation with durable attempt evidence
required_by.E: moving desired state, cancelable scheduled action, or bound result application or interleaving
